question: Who issues internship introductory letters at ACity?
answer: Internship introductory letters are issued exclusively by the Career Services Office, signed by the Career Services Manager (or the Dean of Students where necessary). The Registry does NOT issue these letters. Contact the Career Services Office at careerservices@acity.edu.gh or call +233 543 321 525.
keywords: internship letter, introductory letter, career services, registry

question: What are the requirements to get an internship letter from ACity?
answer: To qualify for an internship introductory letter, undergraduate students must meet ALL of the following: (1) Maintain at least 80% attendance in the immediate past or current semester, (2) Attend the University's Career Fair when organised, (3) Have no injunction or disciplinary case from the ACity Disciplinary Committee or SCA, (4) Remain in good standing with Career Services, and (5) Complete all modules in the DigiVibe Career Essentials Program. Graduate students and penultimate year students on Industrial Attachment are also eligible.
keywords: internship letter requirements, career services, attendance, DigiVibe, industrial attachment

question: What happens if a student falsifies attendance at ACity?
answer: Falsifying attendance (e.g., signing for workshops or classes you did not attend) is a serious offense under the Student Code of Conduct. As per the Student Handbook, it constitutes falsification of university records and a fraudulent act. Sanctions include immediate suspension, dismissal, and a report to the police. Students found engaging in this practice are referred to the Disciplinary Committee.
keywords: attendance falsification, fraud, disciplinary, suspension, dismissal, student code of conduct

question: When does the ACity hostel close for the end of semester vacation in 2026?
answer: The hostel will officially close for the end of Semester 2 vacation on Sunday, 3rd May 2026, at 12:00 PM. All residents must complete their check-out process before this time.
keywords: hostel closing, hostel vacation, check-out, semester break, May 2026

question: What are the hostel check-out instructions at ACity?
answer: Before leaving the hostel at end of semester, students must: (1) Remove all personal belongings from their room and wardrobe — only refrigerators may be left in lounge areas (must be logged with hostel coordinators), (2) Dispose of all trash — belongings left behind will be discarded, (3) Leave wardrobes UNLOCKED — locked wardrobes will be forcibly opened and contents discarded, with repair costs billed to the student, (4) Have a hostel coordinator inspect the room and sign out before leaving, (5) Note that any unreported room damages will be billed to the occupant's account. Failure to comply results in penalties upon return. Contact: sca@acity.edu.gh.
keywords: hostel check-out, hostel rules, wardrobe, room inspection, sign-out, vacation

question: Is ACity responsible for items left in the hostel during vacation?
answer: No. The university will not be responsible for any lost items left in hostel lounge areas during vacation. Only refrigerators may be left in the lounge, and they must be logged with the hostel coordinators before departure.
keywords: hostel items, lost items, vacation, fridge, lounge, responsibility

question: Is mentorship sign-off required for graduation at ACity?
answer: Yes. Effective the 2025/2026 academic year, all graduating students must obtain their mentor's sign-off as part of the official graduation clearance process under the Academic Mentoring Programme. Students must either register for mentorship via the academic mentorship form or submit a completed Mentorship Engagement Verification Form signed by both the student and their mentor.
keywords: mentorship, graduation clearance, mentor sign-off, graduation requirement, academic mentoring

question: How do I register for mentorship at ACity for graduation clearance?
answer: If you missed the mentorship registration deadline, you can still register via the academic mentorship form at https://forms.gle/GnX3G7ZkhbRDRryL7. You will be assigned a mentor who will be contacted for your graduation clearance in your final year. Alternatively, if you have already been engaging with a mentor, submit a Mentorship Engagement Verification Form (signed by you and your mentor) via https://forms.gle/Vr8Lgh86XSKRFKa16. Contact Career Services at careerservices@acity.edu.gh or call +233 543 321 525 for help.
keywords: mentorship registration, graduation clearance, mentor form, career services
